description: Repo-scale (kotlin-inventory): add an atomic all-or-nothing bulk stock-movement endpoint
prompts: Add `POST /api/items/{id}/movements/bulk`, body `{ movements: [{type, quantity, note}, ...] }`. It must apply the whole batch ATOMICALLY: simulate the running quantity across ALL movements in the batch first (in order) - if any single movement is invalid (bad type, non-positive quantity) OR the simulated quantity would go negative at ANY point in the batch, reject with 400 and apply NONE of the movements (the item's quantity and movement history must be completely unchanged). Only after the entire batch is proven safe should any movement actually be recorded. On success, return `{ movements: [...], item }` (the final item state after the whole batch).
name: add_kotlin_inventory_bulk_movements_atomic
